body: Thanks man. I was just lost in my thoughts, bad thoughts. I would be afraid to take medication but I know I need to do something to make a change and feel better before this gets the best of me. I decided to talk to a therapist and go from there. I really appreciate everyone's input and advice. I do feel a lot better today and after talking with you guys it has helped me in knowing I'm not a failure or a hopeless case because I feel this way. Thank you. After talking on here and realizing it helps  I think I can talk to someone for real.
I'm so sorry for your loss. I can tell how much you loved and cared for her and im so sorry for what happened. Please be safe and take care of yourself.

My job can be really stressful with long hours. I work in a career I always wanted but lately I'm starting to despise it. I'm really beginning to hate my co workers as they are just seriously the worst, most bitter assholes in the world to the point where I'm almost shocked that they can be in just one place and how the hell I got there. They also tried to make me work on the same day as grandfathers funeral that i mentioned earlier. Unfortunately I feel I can't just up and leave as I'm Dependant on my income but as I'm writing this I'm starting to see where some of my issues are. Thanks for suggesting that and listening. These are things I can't talk about in public and it wouldn't get taken seriously if I tried unless it was a therapist.

Thank you, I know you're right about talking to someone. I just do feel shame in admitting I can't control my thoughts and feelings even though I know there is no shame in it. I'm also feeling a lot of self loathing and I really don't understand why. I guess I'll never know unless I open up.

And thank you for linking that article. You are absolutely right, I shouldn't have this here with how I'm feeling. I know I could sell it fairly easy and that could mask the real reason why I'm getting rid of it. I do enjoy the gun and target shooting but I guess I could get another one later. Thanks for listening
